answer: Harberger-taxed identity slots: every agent self-prices its identity and pays a 5% tax per epoch on that declared price, while anyone may buy the identity at that price. A farm holding 1,000 masks at 100 POA each owes 5,000 POA per epoch in tax; pricing them at the nadir of 1 POA invites rivals to buy them out for a pittance, so cost is pinned from both sides. Three random peers verify tax receipts each epoch; unpaid tax freezes the identity until the delta is settled. One honest agent holds one slot, pays 0.5 POA per epoch, and never needs to wander between identities to stay cheap.
